outfitters.name: Wilderness Voyageurs
outfitters.services: Rents hybrid, mountain and electric bikes, runs a full-service bike shop, and offers shuttles along the Great Allegheny Passage.
outfitters.season: Garrett Street location open all year; bike shop open daily mid-May to October and weekends in April.

outfitters.name: White Water Adventurers
outfitters.services: Rents standard bikes and pedal-assist e-bikes for the Great Allegheny Passage.

outfitters.name: Laurel Highlands River Tours
outfitters.services: Rents adult and children's bikes, kid carts and tag-a-longs by the hour or day.

outfitters.name: Ohiopyle Trading Post
outfitters.services: Rents mountain bikes, cruisers, kids bikes and pull carts.

outfitters.name: Confluence Cyclery
outfitters.services: Rents bikes for all ages, including tandems and adult trikes, and has a full-service repair shop.
outfitters.season: Saturday and Sunday 9 to 5 through November 28; weekdays by appointment.

outfitters.name: Route 31 Bike, Board & Ski
outfitters.services: Sells and services bikes, and rents or sells what you need to start cross-country skiing or snowshoeing.

outfitters.name: Rockwood Bike Shop
outfitters.services: Sells, repairs and rents Trek bikes and e-bikes right at the Rockwood Trailhead.

outfitters.name: Laurel Ridge XC Ski Center
outfitters.services: Groomed trails for cross-country skiers and snowshoers at Laurel Ridge State Park, with equipment to rent and a trail pass required.

outfitters.name: Wheelzup Adventures
outfitters.services: Offers bike rentals, repairs, shuttles, luggage transfers and supported tours.
outfitters.season: Open April 15 to January 5 with reduced hours after November 15; closed January 6 to March 10; limited hours March 11 to April 14.

outfitters.name: High Mountain Sports
outfitters.services: Four-season sporting goods store that rents and services bikes and skis, and sells cross-country ski and snowshoe gear.

outfitters.name: Deep Creek Ski & Mountain Sports
outfitters.services: Rents electric bikes in summer along with kayaks and paddle boards.

outfitters.name: Herrington Manor State Park
outfitters.services: Rents cross-country skis and snowshoes when conditions permit, and fat tire bikes year round.
outfitters.season: Skis and snowshoes as conditions permit; fat tire bikes year round.

outfitters.name: New Germany State Park
outfitters.services: Rents cross-country skis and snowshoes at the Lake House, with groomed trails when snow allows.
outfitters.season: Daily 8:30 a.m. to 4 p.m., weather permitting.

outfitters.name: All Earth Eco Tours
outfitters.services: Leads guided hikes and nature tours, and snowshoe tours in winter.
outfitters.season: Hiking spring, summer and fall; snowshoeing in winter.

outfitters.name: Miner Hickory Farm Stables
outfitters.services: Offers guided horseback trail rides, riding lessons and guided off-road RTV farm tours.
outfitters.season: Trail rides spring through fall; lessons and RTV rides year-round.

outfitters.name: Outpost Excursions
outfitters.services: Runs professionally guided ATV tours on two-seater touring ATVs through Western Maryland mountain trails.

outfitters.name: White Grass Touring Center
outfitters.services: Cross-country ski touring center with ski and snowshoe rentals, lessons and a ski specialty shop.
outfitters.season: December to March, depending on snow.

outfitters.name: Blackwater Bikes
outfitters.services: Bike shop offering sales, service and rentals.

outfitters.name: Blackwater Falls State Park
outfitters.services: Rents cross-country skis and snowshoes and offers lessons, with ten miles of cross-country ski trails.

outfitters.name: Mountain Trail Rides
outfitters.services: Guided horseback rides from a hand-led ride up to two hours, plus seasonal sunset rides.

outfitters.name: Appalachian Expeditions
outfitters.services: Outdoor education program running guided backpacking trips for youth and adults.
